context: Crossfilter dashboard with three linked charts (horizontal bar, multi-line, scatter) and a reduced-motion toggle — a data visualization / interactive tool.
first_impression: Functionally clean with a principled colorblind-safe palette, but the chaotic tangle of six overlapping lines in the center panel and a completely empty lower half of the viewport undercut the otherwise competent layout.
what_works: Deliberate use of the Tol colorblind-safe palette instead of schemeCategory10 shows real design intent; ghost bars behind the foreground bars are an elegant crossfilter affordance that communicates context without noise.
what_doesnt: The line chart renders six heavily overlapping colored lines with no legend, making it nearly unreadable — category identity is lost without hovering over each line individually. The dashboard occupies only the top half of the viewport, leaving a large dead zone below that makes the layout feel unfinished.
